newsitem.title: UK: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel soft.
newsitem.headline: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel soft.

text.p: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel oil was softer on Thursday as crude oil futures headed lower and Russian supply continued to emerge, traders said.
Dealers said the market was close to or already below the $104 cif ARA heard to have been paid on Wednesday for a good quality E-4 cargo arriving around this weekend.
At least two more prompt Russian cargoes were heard to be available in the hands of traders, but no more business was heard done.
